messages:
Maria (support): forwarding an urgent customer escalation from ACME. Admin user says they lost access to Billing and to 'models' list in console after last RBAC migration. They see `permission denied` on both.
Evan (sec): thanks. any customer id / user id we can use to search audit logs?
Maria (support): customer id  org_acme_42, affected user email: alice@acme.com. She reports no roles visible in dropdown. Sending screenshots.
Maria (support): Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/locked_console.png
AuditBot: New ACL migration deployed by `rbac-migrate-2026-03-19` at 1765234520. Changed 7 role bindings.
Evan (sec): that migration touched `org_admin` -> removed some permissive globs. I want the audit logs for the user's access failures. Run `SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE resource='console' AND user_email='alice@acme.com' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;`
Jess (eng-sre): I can query the infra audit index, give me a minute.
Jess (eng-sre): result: multiple `access_denied` entries for `billing.view` and `models.list` from 1765234545 onwards. The policy shows `org_admin` lost `billing.*` due to a bad glob rewrite.
Evan (sec): yikes. did the migration also update role -> permission mappings in db? or just the in-memory policy cache?
Infra Bot: rbac-migrate-2026-03-19: jobs/1045 finished. persisting changes to `role_permissions` table.
Jess (eng-sre): looks persisted. quick mitigation: we can re-add the missing permissions to `org_admin` and invalidate the auth cache so console picks it up immediately.
Jess (eng-sre): proposed SQL to run on auth-db:
```
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_name, permission) VALUES ('org_admin', 'billing.view') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_name, permission) VALUES ('org_admin', 'models.list') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
COMMIT;
```
Evan (sec): also add `billing.payments`? Customer says they couldn't see invoices.
Jess (eng-sre): adding that too. running now.
Jess (eng-sre): ran SQL, got OK. Now invalidating caches: `/api/internal/auth/invalidate?scope=org_acme_42`
Infra Bot: cache invalidation request accepted for org_acme_42 by jess (1765234672).
Maria (support): ACME reports access restored. Alice confirmed she can see Billing and Models again. :tada:
Evan (sec): good. initial root cause: the glob-to-explicit mapping script replaced `billing.*` with a narrower set but missed `billing.view` and `billing.payments` for org_admin due to a regex bug.
Sam (product): assign P0 postmortem? we should add a smoke test for console role visibility in the migration pipeline.
Evan (sec): agreed. I'll own the postmortem. actions: (1) revert migration script change in repo, (2) add smoke test, (3) add a pre-deploy audit check that compares previous and new permission sets and flags removals of broad perms.
Maria (support): created support ticket and updated ACME. Ticket 2468: customer notified and compensated for downtime.
Jess (eng-sre): also noticed audit logs for a KMS access error around the same time but unrelated: `kms:decrypt denied` for a service account used in a Canary job. filed issue infra#782 to follow up.
Evan (sec): good catch. add that to the security backlog but separate from this incident.
Sam (product): timeline and owners? Evan (postmortem), Jess (fix + infra smoke test), Maria (customer comms), Evan assign to security backlog for KMS follow-up.
Maria (support): closing the customer escalation. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
Evan (sec): leaving a short incident note in #postmortems with link to ticket 2468 and migration id `rbac-migrate-2026-03-19`.
AuditBot: Incident record created: IR-2026-03-19-07, severity: S2, owners: evan, jess.
